differences.a_observable: Vibrant blue and yellow color bleeding on the white card from adjacent elements.
differences.b_observable: Flat white lighting on the card with no colored bounce light.
differences.fix: Enable global illumination or add colored bounce lights to simulate light transfer between materials.

differences.a_observable: Brushed metal texture with anisotropic reflections on the right background plate.
differences.b_observable: Flat, matte grey plastic texture on the background plate.
differences.fix: Apply a brushed metal material with anisotropic roughness to the background plate.

differences.a_observable: Shallow depth of field causing the top card to be noticeably blurred.
differences.b_observable: Deep depth of field with the top card remaining perfectly sharp.
differences.fix: Enable depth of field in the camera settings and focus on the center card.

json.highest_impact_fix: Add anisotropic brushed metal textures to the background plates and enable global illumination to capture colored bounce lighting.
